meta: Pick trustworthy AI news sources and cut the clickbait: following twenty channels only makes you feel you're always behind.

muc.title: Following too many channels
muc.text: Following twenty AI news channels doesn't help you understand more; it just makes you feel always behind.

muc.title: Three kinds of sources
muc.text: Pick few but good: the company's official page, a tech outlet that cites sources, and one person who explains things simply.

muc.title: Drop clickbait channels
muc.text: Unfollow any channel that keeps saying urgent or shocking, or that sells a course with every post.

muc.title: Once a week
muc.text: Read the news once a week instead of every hour. Ask a chatbot to summarize what you saved, then pick one thing worth trying.

muc.title: Clean your follow list
muc.text: Open your follow list, unfollow three clickbait channels, and keep one official source.
